tasks = sorted(list(set(t[0] for t in data)))
workers = sorted(list(set(t[1] for t in data)))
valid_workers = [w for w in workers if w != 'Dune']
import itertools
min_cost = 999999
for p in itertools.permutations(valid_workers, len(tasks)):
    mapping = dict(zip(tasks, p))
    cost = 0
    possible = True
    for t, w in mapping.items():
        matching = [c for task, worker, c in data if task == t and worker == w]
        if matching:
            cost += matching[0]
        else:
            possible = False
            break
    if possible and cost < min_cost:
        min_cost = cost
result = min_cost
